cohort: The cohort consisted of 144 pregnant women with anemia and 144 pregnant women without anemia, all receiving prenatal care in their third trimester between April 2021 and March 2022.
finding: Maternal anemia was correlated with adverse neonatal and maternal outcomes, including a significantly higher incidence of small for gestational age (SGA) infants.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in the rates of cesarean section between anemic and non-anemic women.
